notes: Added missing schema refinement, core presence logic, and observability coverage without duplicating prior stories.

stories.title: Refine Disciplinary Signal Response Contract
stories.description: Extend the disciplinary signal response schema to explicitly include fields for presence_indicator (boolean), board_url (string|null), state (string), and availability_status (supported|unsupported|missing), ensuring backward compatibility with existing consumers.

stories.title: Implement Disciplinary Presence Indicator Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic logic to compute a presence_indicator flag based on whether a provider’s state has a supported medical board mapping and a valid constructed URL, without performing external lookups or scraping.

stories.title: Add Observability for Disciplinary Signal Generation
stories.description: Instrument disciplinary signal generation with debug logging to capture state resolution, mapping selection, and fallback paths, enabling traceability without exposing sensitive data.
